title: ToT Storefront compliance config (.tot/config.json#/compliance)
description: Regulated-commerce configuration. IMPORTANT: the mandated LEGAL WORDING for every notice is platform-owned and rendered by the platform's compliance widgets. You only flip flags and pass small parameters (minAge, chemical names, state lists). A widget renders NOTHING when its field is absent. Never fabricate facts; never remove/hide/paraphrase a required warning; enforcement/decisions/calculations stay platform-owned.

minAge.description: Minimum purchase age (e.g. 21). Presence signals the tenant is age/identity regulated.

nicotineWarning.description: Show the FDA-mandated nicotine warning (wording fixed by law).

pactAct.description: Show the PACT Act notice (ENDS/vapor). Federal wording fixed by the platform.

shippingRestriction.description: Display text for shipping restrictions. The ship/no-ship DECISION stays platform-owned.

prop65.description: California Prop 65 warning. The mandated skeleton, symbol, and URL are platform-owned; you supply only harm endpoint(s) and chemical name(s).

stateEligibility.description: DISPLAY only — does not decide eligibility for a cart/address.

exciseTax.description: DISPLAY cue only — the platform NEVER computes tax here; calculation is platform/commerce-owned.
